download_dog_image.description: Download a dog picture as a file, so a later step can attach it to an email, post it to a chat or put it in storage. description: Pull dog pictures and breed data into a workflow from the Dog CEO API: a random dog, a random pick from one breed, or every picture of a breed a page at a time. Browse or search the full catalogue of nearly a hundred breeds and their sub-breeds, look one up to see how many pictures exist, pick a breed at random, and download a picture to post or attach. Every picture comes back with the breed it shows and alt text ready to caption it. No account or API key required.
